aboutUs.text1: At Texx, we set out to bring to Romania the finest and most elegant home textiles. Located in the heart of Brașov, our company offers premium labor services for curtains and draperies, along with an exclusive range of the highest-quality materials. For us, every curtain and every drapery is more than just a decorative element – they are an expression of refinement and good taste.
aboutUs.text2: We use top-quality fabrics, imported from the most renowned manufacturers, to create elegant curtains and draperies that harmoniously combine beauty and functionality. Additionally, we specialize in linen curtains, a noble, natural, and durable material that adds an extra touch of style to any interior.
aboutUs.text3: In addition to curtains and draperies, we are also dedicated to manufacturing luxurious cushions, crafted for ultimate comfort. Whether decorative or designed for rest, each product is made with meticulous attention to detail, using fine materials and high-quality fillings. Moreover, we offer a collection of premium bedspreads designed to perfectly complement the decor of an elegant and sophisticated bedroom.
aboutUs.text4: We aim to offer our customers not just products, but a unique experience in which the quality of the materials and the craftsmanship are paramount. By choosing [Company Name], you choose a team passionate about textiles, with a clear mission: to transform every home into a warm, elegant, and comfortable space.
aboutUs.text5: We invite you to discover our collections and benefit from personalized craftsmanship services, specially created to fulfill all your desires for curtains, draperies, cushions, and bedspreads. Quality defines us, and our customers’ satisfaction is our greatest reward!

section6.content: Any issues regarding the nature or quantities delivered must be reported within 48 hours of receiving the package. www.perdele-online.ro will try to resolve such issues as quickly and favorably as possible. section7.content: Warranties offered by www.perdele-online.ro: you are guaranteed a refund within 10 days if the product does not meet your requirements. Warranties provided by the manufacturer are indicated on each product’s page (6, 12, or 24 months).

section8.content: If the product you ordered does not match the description on www.perdele-online.ro, has manufacturing or other defects, or does not meet your expectations according to applicable law, you may request a replacement or a refund within 10 days of receipt.
